SQL queries with per query pricing
With per query pricing, you pay only for the queries you run. To estimate your monthly cost, enter the total number of queries you expect to run in a day, week, or month and the amount of data scanned per query.

SQL queries with capacity based pricing
With capacity based pricing, you can pay an hourly price for compute resources to run your queries. You pay only for the capacity you need, measured in Data Processing Units (DPUs), and the time capacity is active in your account. To estimate your monthly cost, enter the number of DPUs and time needed.
Number of DPUs
A single Data Processing Unit (DPU) typically provides 4 vCPU and 16 GB of memory. Minimum of 4 DPUs per Capacity Reservation and minimum increment of 4 DPUs.

Unit conversions
Amount of data scanned per query: 1 GB x 0.0009765625 TB in a GB = 0.0009765625 TB
Pricing calculations
Rounding (10) = 10 Rounded total number of queries
10 queries per month x 0.0009765625 TB x 5.00 USD = 0.05 USD
SQL queries with per query cost (monthly): 0.05 USD
RoundUp (4) = 4 DPUs (increments of 4)
4 DPUs x 1 hours per month x 0.30 USD per DPU hour = 1.20 USD
SQL queries with capacity based cost (monthly): 1.20 USD
0.05 USD monthly queries cost + 1.20 USD monthly DPUs cost = 1.25 USD
Total SQL queries cost (monthly): 1.25 USD
